title: Multi-Tenant Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & API Token Authentication Review Package
author: Antigravity & Codex

overview.goal: Cryptographic multi-tenant workspace isolation and staff role-based access control (admin, manager, sales_rep)
overview.summary: Implemented zero-dependency HMAC-SHA256 session token generation and verification in ai_inbox/core/auth.py, strict tenant cross-access isolation (rejecting foreign workspace requests with 403 Forbidden), role permission matrices for admin, manager, and sales_rep, and integrated enforcement into ai_inbox/api/server.py.

verification.status: PASSED (100% token validation, tampering rejection, role checks, and tenant isolation)
